claim: A failed quote refresh no longer leaves an outdated summary with the submit enabled
evidence: CheckoutForm.tsx:203 `stale = quote !== null && quoteKey !== currentKey`; quoteKey is set only on a successful quote (:224, :275), so after a change whose quote fails the button is disabled (:790) and the retry is offered (:762-771). Rendered: pass3 'cities-failed'/'policies-stale' rows show the disabled/enabled states as designed.

claim: A press answered by a Turnstile failure is dropped and never submits later without a new press
evidence: CheckoutForm.tsx:208 `if (turnstileFailed && awaitingToken) setAwaitingToken(false)`; pass3 turnstile-error/blocked: after the press the button reads «تأكيد الطلب», not waiting, and the alert «تعذّر تحميل التحقق؛ حدّث الصفحة.» shows.

claim: City list failures and an empty list are no longer silent
evidence: Holds in the checkout (CheckoutForm.tsx:690-710, pass3 cities-failed «تعذّر تحميل قائمة المدن.» with retry, no-cities «لا نوصل إلى أي مدينة حاليًا.» with the submit disabled) but not in the cart: CartView.tsx:116 still `.catch(() => setCities([]))`, rendered with no message and no retry (pass2 cart-cities-fail). Reported as STORE-UI-08.

claim: The coupon field is capped at 64 and an over-long saved coupon is dropped with a note
evidence: maxLength={MAX_COUPON} on both coupon inputs (CartView.tsx:344, CheckoutForm.tsx:554); readSavedCoupon (cart.ts:367-372) drops a longer saved value and both pages show «كود الخصم المحفوظ أطول من المسموح، فأُزيل. أعد إدخاله.»

claim: A stale cart tab no longer overwrites what another tab added
evidence: Every edit goes through updateStoredCart (cart.ts:316-322), which applies the change to the latest stored cart; CartProvider.tsx:38-43 re-reads on the storage event.

claim: A NOT_FOUND from pay or cancel forgets the stored order instead of leaving the tab stuck
evidence: HoldView.tsx:120-121 and :185-186 call onForget, CheckoutForm.tsx:250-258 clears the pending order and the key and shows the form with the message.

claim: A failed cart quote offers a retry
evidence: CartView.tsx:213-220 «أعد المحاولة» bumps `retry`, which re-runs the quote effect (:150); pass2 cart-quote-fails shows the alert and the button.

claim: Dedication inputs carry the line's name
evidence: CartView.tsx:299 aria-label={`نص الإهداء: ${name}`}.

claim: A capped add says how many were added
evidence: AddToCart.tsx:156-160 «أُضيف N فقط: الحد الأقصى 20 لكل منتج. في السلة الآن M.» and the nothing-added sentence at :151.

claim: The store grid no longer paints unfilled cells aubergine
evidence: store.module.css:63-82 draws the lines with each card's box-shadow and the grid has no background; shots/p1-store-768.png (three products in two columns) shows the sand band, not aubergine, in the empty cell.

claim: Removing a cart line moves focus on and announces it
evidence: CartView.tsx:153-159 focusAfter and the always-mounted status line (:185-189).

claim: Checkout field errors are announced
evidence: CheckoutForm.tsx:504-509 error spans carry role="alert"; pass3 after an empty submit: five alerts, focus on #checkout-email.

claim: The hold view no longer claims a live hold after it ended
evidence: HoldView.tsx:149-153 one timer to holdEnds calls pay, which ends the view on HOLD_EXPIRED (pass4 hold-hold-expired: «انتهت مدة حجز الطلب.» and the stored order and key cleared). Ceiling as recorded: one shot, not re-armed if the device clock runs ahead.

claim: «تحديث» on the return page keeps the focus while it asks
evidence: PaymentReturn.tsx:191 aria-disabled with a busy guard. The same pattern is missing on the checkout's buttons: STORE-UI-03.

claim: /orders and /notify are calm pages (title fade only, no reveals)
evidence: src/components/weave/MotionLayer.tsx:17 CALM = ['/cart', '/checkout', '/policies', '/orders', '/notify'] and the effect returns before mountReveals for them.

claim: A static money page bakes no loading line that only script could end
evidence: Holds for /orders (out/orders.html has no loading text) but /cart, /checkout and /checkout/return still bake «جارٍ تحميل السلة…», «جارٍ تحميل الطلب…», «جارٍ التحقق من الدفع…» (pass1 no-JS rows). Reported as STORE-UI-01.

claim: The checkout link is hidden while a cart line is refused
evidence: CartView.tsx:417-423; shots/p2-cart-refused-1024.png shows «أزل غير المتاح أو عدّل الكمية لإتمام الطلب.» and no link.

claim: A stale build never shows a preorder date that has passed
evidence: VariantAction.tsx:90-92 preorderCurrent compares with today in Riyadh; :151 passes it to rowView.

claim: The hold view says a payment arrived only for a settled status or UNDER_REVIEW
evidence: HoldView.tsx:53-65 shownBy; pass4 hold-blocked-mode/attempts show «تعذّر تجهيز الدفع لهذا الطلب. ألغِ الطلب ثم اطلب من جديد.» with the cancel, hold-received-review shows «وصلتنا دفعة هذا الطلب.».

claim: The #test= sandbox fragment is read on the store and product pages too
evidence: CartLink.tsx:90 readTestFragment() on mount; CartLink is mounted by both store pages.
